description: Look up one StackLégal provider fiche by canonical slug, alias (for example ga), or exact catalog name. Returns the same object as GET /api/v1/providers/{slug}. A name match is not a legal qualification. lang defaults to French.

lang.description: Optional shipped locale. Omit for French. Slugs do not change with language.

slug_or_name.description: Canonical slug, alias, or exact provider name as shown on the fiche.
